thread:
andrea: Heads-up: postsubmit auto-promote failed during the release window. Integration job `session-dump-seed` is flaky and is preventing the cut.

deploy-bot: Auto-promotion halted: postsubmit failed (integration-tests). See CI: https://ci.redwood/reports/rel-1223 :warning:

sam: Reproduced locally a couple times. Failing seed flips between runs (SEED=1734 then SEED=2910). Looks nondeterministic.

prateek: This aligns with the test-runner concurrency tweak we merged last night (runner-concurrency=4). I can see teardown ordering differences that could cause shared-fixture races.

andrea: We have three choices: (A) manual-promote last-known-good image for the demo, (B) kick a rebuild with runner-concurrency=1 to validate, or (C) dig into the harness fix now. Timebox is short. Thoughts?

carmen: Hard preference to avoid skipping integrations. Demo in ~80m though. How quickly can we get a rebuilt image?

sam: A rebuild with the old concurrency should finish in ~18-25m if I start it now. But if it's a true race it might still show up. Manual promote is fastest.

prateek: Manual promote is OK but require clear rollback/playbook and a follow-up issue. Also run a smoke suite post-promote.

andrea: If we manual-promote, command is: ``deploybot promote --image=sha256:9a7c11 --reason="temp-unblock-release-window-flaky-integration"``. That bypasses auto checks but runs smoke. Any objections? :thinking_face:

carmen: Approve only if we: 1) create a postmortem ticket, 2) have an automated toggle to revert to auto-promote within 2 hours, 3) notify oncall and release stakeholders.

sam: I'll start the reduced-concurrency rebuild in parallel. If it passes full postsubmit we can swap the image later.

andrea: OK I'm going to proceed with a manual promote for the demo. Kicking in 1m. @deploy-bot please run smoke and route to staged slot.

deploy-bot: Promotion initiated by andrea. Running smoke tests (smoke-suite-v2) and routing 5% traffic to staged.

deploy-bot: Smoke tests: 0/12 failed, all checks green. Promotion complete. Traffic routed to stage. :rocket:

andrea: I've opened CHOWN-55: "unstable session-dump-seed after runner concurrency change" and assigned to @prateek and @sam. I'll attach failing seeds and CI traces.

carmen: OK for demo. Please ensure the rollback toggle is in place and add a short note to release notes about the manual promote.

prateek: Starting triage now. I'll validate the reduced-concurrency rebuild Sam started and run a seeds sweep. If rebuild is clean we can redeploy and revoke the manual promote.

andrea: Closing thread for now 61; release window unblocked. Follow-ups in CHOWN-55 and #release-notes. Thanks everyone.
